programs.title: Long Story Short
programs.desc: Ellen and her friends all dream of living in the perfect relationship with their one true match—but their real lives are far removed from these romantic ideals. We follow them over three years and eight parties, as they navigate countless complications and each experience their own emotional highs and lows in love.

programs.title: Unfaithful
programs.desc: Connie, a middle-aged wife and mother, has an affair with Paul, a handsome young Frenchman. When Connie's husband, Edward, becomes suspicious, he hires a private investigator. When his fears are confirmed, Edward confronts Paul in a decision that will come to haunt him.

programs.title: The House
programs.desc: 27-year-old French writer Emma immerses herself in Berlin's sex trade to research her novel. What begins as brief research becomes a two-year journey of desire, danger and discovery.

programs.title: Oink
programs.desc: A young girl sets out to prove to her disapproving mother she can house-train the endearing but unruly little piglet she gets as a birthday gift from her estranged oddball grandfather.

programs.title: A Great Friend
programs.desc: A man breaks down on the side of a mountain road. Another stops to offer help. A seemingly innocuous encounter that will prove to be a decisive turning point in each of their lives. Yet everything seems to oppose them. But, forced to live together for two days in the heart of spectacular nature, they will both stop lying to each other and finally find their smiles again. Thanks to each other. And what if their meeting wasn't by chance...

programs.title: The Orator
programs.desc: This acclaimed film is the first entirely shot in Samoa. Saili, a taro farmer, attempts to reclaim his father's chief status by proving his oratory skills are good enough to lead the community.
